verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document scoped or least-privilege Render API credentials that a user can issue to an agent. OAuth sign-in for the MCP server (render-docs-26) is an authentication method with no documented scoping. Managed OIDC (render-docs-30) gives Render services short-lived tokens for Anthropic and OpenAI, which is outbound service identity, not agent credentials for Render. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
